capabilities: Add CSS classes to text matching regular expressions
Create custom Markdown-like tags with open/close syntax
Scope rules per view mode (reading, live preview, source) and inside code
Enable rules per file path or frontmatter property value
Import and export rule sets for sharing or backup
disambiguation: Not a regex find-and-replace tool; it only wraps matched text in CSS classes for styling.
extras: README warns that one broken regex can prevent Obsidian from opening a file and must be removed manually. Author discloses using AI (Copilot, ChatGPT) for some experimental code and credits rien7 as the original author.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to style arbitrary text patterns with custom CSS classes or to define custom Markdown-like tags.
summary: Regex-based styler that wraps text matching user-defined patterns in CSS classes for custom text rendering.
